families.label: Strict Monochrome
families.description: The interface relies entirely on black, white, and greys, with no distinct accent color for interactive elements, letting product imagery provide all color.

families.label: Sparse Functional Accents
families.description: Accent color is used sparingly, primarily to highlight interactive elements like primary buttons, links, and widgets.

families.label: Promotional Accents
families.description: Accent color is reserved almost exclusively to draw attention to sales, discounts, and promotional badges.

families.label: Liberal Color Usage
families.description: Brand or bright colors are used liberally across the interface for backgrounds, badges, highlights, and buttons.

families.label: Static Message
families.description: The bar displays a single, persistent message without any animation or rotation.

families.label: Message Carousel
families.description: The bar cycles through multiple messages, typically providing arrows for manual navigation.

families.label: Carousel with Playback Controls
families.description: The rotating message carousel includes explicit pause or play buttons to control the animation.

families.label: Dismissible Bar
families.description: The announcement bar includes a close button, allowing the shopper to remove it from their view.

families.label: Scrolling Marquee
families.description: The text continuously scrolls horizontally across the screen in a marquee effect.

families.label: mid-page-split-feature
families.description: The brand's value propositions are presented mid-page in a split layout with text on one side and a lifestyle image on the other.

families.label: interleaved-with-merchandising
families.description: Sections explaining brand value propositions and ingredients are placed between product shopping blocks.

families.label: mid-page-text-block
families.description: The brand's value proposition appears halfway down the page in a dedicated, solid-color text block, following product merchandising and social proof.

families.label: Standard Vertical Column
families.description: The purchase interface is grouped into a single, static vertical column, typically on the right side of the page.

families.label: Sticky Scroll Column
families.description: The purchase column remains fixed in place on the screen while the user scrolls through the product images.

families.label: Split Buy Box
families.description: The purchase elements are divided, placing the title and price above the images and the selection and checkout buttons below.

families.label: slide-out-cart-drawer
families.description: The cart interface slides in from the right edge of the screen, overlaying the page content.

families.label: icon-with-badge
families.description: The cart is represented by a bag icon in the header, featuring a numerical badge for item count.

families.label: Single Column Stack
families.description: Products are displayed in a single vertical column, typically spanning the full width of the viewport.

families.label: Strict Two-Column Grid
families.description: Products are arranged in a continuous, unbroken two-column layout without promotional interruptions.

families.label: Interrupted Two-Column Grid
families.description: A two-column product grid that is periodically broken by promotional tiles or full-width editorial sections.

families.label: Strict Multi-Column Grid
families.description: Products are arranged in a rigid, uninterrupted three- or four-column layout.

families.label: Interrupted Multi-Column Grid
families.description: A three- or four-column product grid that is occasionally broken by promotional graphics occupying grid cells.

families.label: Standard Horizontal Carousel
families.description: Additional products are displayed in a standard, horizontally scrolling row or carousel.

families.label: Multiple Thematic Carousels
families.description: Recommendations are separated into multiple distinct horizontal carousels based on specific themes or recommendation types.

families.label: Horizontal Bar
families.description: Filtering options are displayed directly above the product grid in a horizontal layout.

families.label: Sidebar Menu
families.description: Filtering options are housed in a persistent vertical sidebar next to the product grid.

families.label: Button Trigger
families.description: Filtering and sorting are hidden behind a button that must be clicked to access the options.

families.label: Sort Only
families.description: The page provides a sorting mechanism but lacks visible filtering options.

families.label: Solid White
families.description: The page uses a consistent, uninterrupted white background from top to bottom.

families.label: Solid Tint or Color
families.description: The page uses a consistent, uninterrupted non-white background color, such as light gray, off-white, or beige.

families.label: White with Contrasting Sections
families.description: The primary background is white, but specific sections use tinted colors, gray bands, or full-bleed images to separate content.

families.label: Color Blocked Sections
families.description: The page background shifts entirely between different solid colors, gradients, or tints for each section, rather than relying on a single base color.

families.label: Left-Aligned Overlay
families.description: A static, full-bleed background image with text and calls-to-action overlaid on the left side.

families.label: Centered Overlay
families.description: A static, full-bleed background image with text and calls-to-action centered directly over the image.

families.label: Carousel Overlay
families.description: A full-bleed image carousel or slider with overlaid text and calls-to-action.

families.label: Promotional Sale Message
families.description: The hero section leads with a direct discount, sale event, or promotional offer to drive immediate conversion.

families.label: Campaign or Collection
families.description: The primary text introduces a new product line, season, or thematic concept rather than a hard promotional discount.

families.label: Purely Visual
families.description: The hero section relies entirely on imagery without overlaid text, deferring messaging to subsequent sections.

families.label: Standard Carousel
families.description: Shoppers browse products by swiping horizontally through one or more standard product carousels.

families.label: Tabbed Carousel
families.description: Shoppers can filter the initial product carousel using built-in tabs for categories or genders.

families.label: Product Grid
families.description: Shoppers are presented with a static, multi-column grid of products immediately following the hero section.

families.label: Hamburger Menu
families.description: Primary navigation is hidden behind a hamburger icon to keep the header compact, often accompanied by utility icons.

families.label: Horizontal Inline Links
families.description: Primary navigation is fully exposed as a horizontal list of links in the same row as the logo and utilities.

families.label: Split Navigation
families.description: The header is split, typically with a centered logo and navigation links on one side balanced by utilities on the other.

families.label: Two-Tier Stacked
families.description: Navigation links are placed in a dedicated second row below the main header containing the logo and utilities.

families.label: Scrollable Navigation
families.description: Categories or subcategories are presented in a horizontally scrollable list, often supplementing a hamburger menu.

families.label: Other
families.description: Navigation architectures that do not fit the primary structural patterns.

families.label: Standard Plain Price
families.description: The price is displayed plainly without any promotional styling, comparative framing, or badges.

families.label: Price with Installments
families.description: The primary price is shown alongside options to pay in installments via third-party services.

families.label: Strikethrough Pricing
families.description: The original price is crossed out next to the new sale price, which may be highlighted in a contrasting color.

families.label: Strikethrough with Badge
families.description: The original price is crossed out and accompanied by a badge highlighting the savings or percentage off.

families.label: Price in CTA
families.description: The price, whether standard or discounted, is displayed directly inside the primary add-to-cart button.

families.label: Horizontal Swipe Carousel
families.description: Shoppers browse images by swiping horizontally through a carousel, often indicated by dots or a progress bar.

families.label: Bottom Thumbnails
families.description: A large main image is displayed with a row of clickable thumbnails positioned below it.

families.label: Left Thumbnails
families.description: A large main image is displayed with a vertical column of clickable thumbnails positioned to its left.

families.label: Vertical Scroll Grid
families.description: Product images are arranged in a grid layout that the shopper scrolls through vertically.

families.label: Static Image
families.description: A single, static product image is displayed without any carousel or thumbnails.

families.label: Isolated Studio Product
families.description: Products are shown exclusively as clean, isolated studio shots on neutral backgrounds.

families.label: Studio Model Only
families.description: Products are presented exclusively on models against a consistent studio backdrop.

families.label: Mixed Gallery
families.description: The same gallery or grid alternates between clean studio shots and contextual lifestyle or model photography.

families.label: Contextual Shift
families.description: The photographic style changes based on the page section, such as using lifestyle images for heroes and studio shots for product cards.

families.label: Stylized Still Life
families.description: Product imagery relies on highly stylized, brightly colored studio shots with props and floating elements rather than simple isolation.

families.label: Basic Static Info
families.description: Cards display only essential, non-interactive product details like the image, title, price, and subtitle.

families.label: Info with Swatches
families.description: Cards include color swatches alongside the basic image, title, and price, allowing shoppers to see available variants.

families.label: Swatches and Ratings
families.description: Cards display social proof via star ratings or reviews in addition to swatches and basic product details.

families.label: Quick Add Actions
families.description: Cards include a prominent call-to-action button or quick-add icon directly on the card for immediate purchasing.

families.label: Vertical Accordions
families.description: Long-form details are hidden within vertically stacked, collapsible accordion panels.

families.label: Horizontal Tabs
families.description: Long-form details are organized into horizontal tabs that reveal different sections of text when clicked.

families.label: Pure Whitespace
families.description: Sections are separated entirely by generous vertical whitespace without any visible lines or background color changes.

families.label: Hard Edge Transitions
families.description: Sections transition abruptly into one another with straight horizontal cuts, often using contrasting full-bleed colors or images.

families.label: Whitespace and Blocks
families.description: Sections transition using a combination of generous whitespace and abrupt changes to full-width colored backgrounds or images.

families.label: Whitespace and Lines
families.description: Sections are divided by generous vertical whitespace punctuated by thin horizontal lines.

families.label: No Social Proof
families.description: The design intentionally omits any form of social proof, such as ratings, reviews, or user-generated content.

families.label: Card-Level Star Ratings
families.description: Social proof is primarily displayed as aggregate star ratings and review counts directly on product cards in grids or carousels.

families.label: Badges Only
families.description: Social proof relies solely on text or graphical badges like 'Best Seller' or awards rather than user ratings or reviews.

families.label: High-Density Multi-Format
families.description: The page features a rich mix of social proof formats, including user-generated content, press logos, videos, or AI summaries.

families.label: Standard PDP Reviews
families.description: Social proof is structured with summary star ratings near the product title and a detailed review section further down the page.

families.label: Other
families.description: Other specific social proof decisions that do not fit the main patterns.

families.label: Text Below CTA
families.description: Trust signals, policies, and guarantees are presented as text or general information blocks immediately below the call to action.

families.label: Icons Below CTA
families.description: Trust signals and guarantees are presented visually as a list of icons immediately below the call to action.

families.label: Serif Display, Sans Body
families.description: A serif typeface is used for headings and titles, paired with a sans-serif for body copy and UI elements.

families.label: All Sans-Serif
families.description: Sans-serif typefaces are used consistently across all headings, body copy, and UI elements.

families.label: Condensed Sans Display
families.description: A bold or heavy condensed sans-serif is used for headings, contrasting with a standard sans-serif for body copy.

families.label: Sans Display, Serif Accents
families.description: A sans-serif is used for primary headings, while a serif is used for secondary text or accents.

families.label: Swatches Only
families.description: Variant selection relies entirely on visual swatches, such as colors or image thumbnails, without text buttons or dropdowns.

families.label: Swatches and Buttons
families.description: Variant selection combines visual swatches for attributes like color with text-based buttons or pills for attributes like size.

families.label: Tiles and Dropdown
families.description: Variant selection uses a combination of visual image tiles and standard dropdown menus.
